title: Export jobs and invoices from Housecall Pro
status: draft: narration follows the platform's help article; check every line against the recording before narrating
sampleData: The platform's authorized demo account with sample clients only. No real names, emails, phone numbers, account ids or payment details on screen.

scenes.narration: This shows how to export past jobs and invoices from Housecall Pro, to keep as each customer's history.
Click Jobs in the left navigation bar. Click Filter, set the completed date range you want to keep, then click Apply.
Click Actions in the top right, then Export, then Send file. Jobs and invoices come in the same file.
Return to Selestial and upload the file you just downloaded.

capture.what: Open the email, download the CSV.
